decisions.statement: The reach is the paths `git-place` says akasha keeps no longer.
A path is read against the folder every worktree of a checkout shares.
A path nothing is at is passed over rather than reported as taken.
A path is taken with everything under it.
What would be taken is answered apart from the taking.
A path that will not go is reported against that path.
Every path is acted on rather than the run ending at the first that refuses.
Nothing a name akasha keeps holds is taken.

definition: what akasha left under the folder git does not track, taken away
